Ari (CS): Heads-up  compact QBR for NorthStar next Tue. Need owners: health snapshot, onboarding playbook, renewal ask, and one-liner customer quotes. 8 slides max. Volunteers?
Ben (CSOps): I6ll take onboarding playbook + two GIFs showing the quick-start flow. Current metric: 71% seats active, time-to-first-value median 9 days. Blocker: SFTP mapping ambiguity.
Clara (CSM): Renewal slide ok for me. Finance warns of negotiation pressure; will prepare two mitigations: concierge + usage commitment, or limited discount with SLA.
Tom (Product): I6ll do the roadmap micro-slide: 4-week quick win (SFTP manifest templates) + Q3 backlog items. Will include dependency flags.
Zoe (Finance): For asks, I6ll model ROI for concierge vs discount. Quick ask: use +10% uplift assumption for concierge and +5% adoption lift for committed usage.
Ari (CS): Action list: Ben upload GIFs + snippet by Mon noon; Clara draft 90/60/30 cadence and pricing scenarios; Tom add dependency lane; Zoe share ROI table. I6ll stitch and own narrative + final slide "Exec Ask".
Ben (CSOps): Uploaded two GIFs and a tiny YAML SFTP sample (sanitized). recording-bot: Reminder: demo recordings must be sanitized and uploaded by Mon 5pm.
Clara (CSM): Drafted renewal slide with checkpoint owners and two pricing flavors. Adding scripted rebuttals for likely exec questions.
Tom (Product): Roadmap micro-slide done. Marked the quick-win as high priority and noted engineering owner. Added one-line perf stat for Hosted vs Dedicated.
Zoe (Finance): Uploaded ROI table. Concierge option reaches payback at month 4 with +10% uplift; discount option delays payback to month 7.
Ari (CS): Please add one-sentence "why it matters" under each slide. Also collect one short customer quote per relevant slide.
Ben (CSOps): Pasted three customer one-liners under onboarding slide (sanitized).
Clara (CSM): Added checks for renewal outreach cadence and owner emails.
Ari (CS): Final: dry run Wed 9am. Rehearsal invite sent. Bring 2 bullets and a possible Q&A line for the ask.
recording-bot: Calendar invite created for Wed 09:00. Agenda: 1) slide run-through 2) rehearse exec ask 3) finalize ROI talking points.
